scope: All 130 mapped Bonnes-Mares parcels and 30 recorded legal-entity identifiers reviewed for Tier 1, including commune edges in both communes, the cadastral named area and the #461 historical extension. The one notice-index candidate was read from its page image; it supports one application event on three current parcels. Producer/company research remains Tier 2. No current farmer is verified.

sources.title: SCEA Domaine d'Eugénie application receipt, dossier 2022-217
sources.finding: The receipt prints Chambolle-Musigny AB304, AB438 and AB440 separately from Gevrey-Chambertin BN34, AC6 and AC287–AC289; 0.6426 ha across both communes, previous operator Maison Bouchard Père et fils. The application was filed and complete on 24 November 2022; the letter is dated 15 December 2022, although its published act ID reads BFC-2023-12-15-00001. The receipt states it does not authorise cultivation.
